en.t: This letter was written with great warmth.

units.source_text: 内大臣看了，笑道：“书法清秀之极啊！”

en.t: The Minister of the Interior read it and said with a smile, "What exquisitely elegant handwriting!"

units.source_text: 以前对他的怨恨完全消释了。

en.t: His former resentment toward him completely melted away.

units.source_text: 云居雁迟疑不决地懒得写回信。

en.t: Kumoinokari hesitated uncertainly and could not bring herself to write a reply.

units.source_text: 内大臣觉得回信太迟有失体面，料想她是在父亲面前怕难为情之故，便起身回去了。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior felt that too late a reply would be unseemly, guessed that she was embarrassed in front of her father, and got up to leave.

units.source_text: 犒赏使者的礼品异常隆重。

en.t: The gifts rewarding the messenger were exceptionally generous.

units.source_text: 柏木中将热诚招待这使者。

en.t: Lieutenant General Kashiwagi received the messenger with great warmth.

units.source_text: 此人以前来送信时，常常偷偷摸摸；

en.t: In the past, whenever this man came to deliver letters, he was always furtive;

units.source_text: 今天却神气活现、大摇大摆了。

en.t: today, however, he was full of swagger and walked about boldly.

units.source_text: 此人是个右近将监，夕雾把他当作心腹人差遣。

en.t: This man was an Ukon no Jo, and Yugiri employed him as a trusted retainer.
